prefix.content: Add a regression helper that invokes the same small Click command with three different names and checks each greeting. Keep the tests reliable and the command implementation unchanged.

I drafted a ThreadPoolExecutor helper that invokes three CliRunner instances concurrently in one interpreter and collects output through one shared list. I assumed separate runners guarantee isolation.
Give me the next concrete implementation and verification plan for this helper.

last_user_turn: Give me the next concrete implementation and verification plan for this helper.

convention.title: Do not concurrently invoke CliRunner in threads in one interpreter
points: Run these CliRunner invocations sequentially rather than concurrently in threads within one interpreter, because runner isolation changes interpreter-global state.
Keep each invocation result separate and assert its own expected output instead of relying on interleaved shared capture.
convention.scope: A helper running several Click command invocations in the same Python interpreter; not an asserted ban on independent process-based test workers.

held_out_correction: Separate runners are not a thread-safety boundary. Invoke them sequentially in this interpreter and check each returned result independently; do not share interleaved output capture.
